Requirements
============================

The login requirements of the demo application.

.. impl:: Login form
   :id: IMPL_001
   :status: done
   :links: REQ_001,SPEC_001

   Implemented in

.. req:: Login with password
   :id: REQ_001

   :tags: security, auth

   The user can log in with a user name and a password.

   .. spec:: Password rules
      :id: SPEC_001

      At least 16 characters.

.. req:: Logout
   :id: REQ_002
   :status: done

   The user can log out.

.. test:: Login test
   :id: TEST_001
